notes: Bible 6.2: the bonded-warehouse seal that customs never cracks; leads to The Crate for Mr. S— (bible 6.1 quest 6). Nell tells it in nell-drowned-gull.
text: Vane crates go into bay nine and customs never cracks a seal. Funny, that.

secondHand.text: Barge folk say Vane's crates go into some bay nine down at Wendmouth and customs never cracks a seal. Funny, that.
